# What URnetworkSdk.dll is built from, and what the three ABI files in
# app/third_party/vendor-include are copied from: urnetwork/message's native composition, at ONE
# commit of each repository below.
#
# The library is one dll, URnetworkSdk.dll. Its package main is the core SDK's (urnetwork/sdk
# cgo/): the handle table, the C-string helpers and the generated exports. The messaging exports
# the app calls (urnet_message_*) are urnetwork/message's sdk/cgo, and sdk/cgo/compose.sh there
# lays the core's package main beside them, so that one c-shared build makes the one library.
#
#   urnetwork_sdk.def    = message's sdk/cgo/include/urnetwork_sdk.def (both halves' exports)
#   urnetwork_message.h  = message's sdk/cgo/include/urnetwork_message.h
#   urnetwork_sdk.h      = sdk's cgo/include/urnetwork_sdk.h (compose.sh lays it beside the other two)
#
# app/tools/build-sdk-dll.ps1 reads this file: it checks out each repository at its commit,
# composes, builds the dll with message's own sdk/cgo/build.sh, and holds the three vendored files
# to the composition byte for byte. CI runs it (build-and-test.yml, job sdk-composition). To move
# a pin, change the line and run build-sdk-dll.ps1 -Vendor in the same commit, so the three files
# never come from another composition than the one named here.
#
# A line is: name url commit. The commit is a full SHA; the url is under
# https://github.com/urnetwork/. The names other than message are exactly the sibling checkouts
# message's sdk/cgo/go.mod replaces by path (../../../<name>), and each commit must equal the one
# message's own scripts/siblings.txt pins at the message commit, so this builds the combination
# message's test.sh tests. build-sdk-dll.ps1 refuses all of these otherwise.
#
# THE GO TOOLCHAIN IS NOT PINNED HERE: it is message's, the toolchain line of its root go.mod at
# the commit below. build-sdk-dll.ps1 forces it on every go command, whatever go command the
# machine has, and the dll is asked which toolchain built it.
#
# MESSAGE, SDK AND CONNECT ARE PULL REQUEST HEADS. The three pull requests are built and tested as
# a set, and none had merged when these lines were written. Each commit is fetched by its SHA
# from the urnetwork repository all the same: a pull request's head is in that repository's fork
# network, and GitHub serves a commit to a fetch by its SHA from any repository of the network.
# Once a pull request has merged with a merge commit, the same SHA is in the repository's own
# history. Until then message's scripts/siblings.txt names the fork each of sdk and connect is
# pushed to as its own fetch source. The pin is the commit, so build-sdk-dll.ps1 compares the
# commit, and prints message's fetch source beside it where it is not the url below.
#
# message: sdk/cgo, the messaging half, its .def, its header, and the scripts that compose, build
# and check the library. The head of the pull request that imports messaging, with its history,
# from connect and the core SDK.
message https://github.com/urnetwork/message.git 4d365abfdb1ab1666def8bd0fdf708625b190e39
#
# sdk: the core SDK, at the head of the pull request that removes messaging from it. compose.sh
# refuses a core that still carries the messaging half, which would export every messaging
# function twice.
sdk https://github.com/urnetwork/sdk.git 0f03e27e1482a4e77811c5982005c853b5a7b1ca
#
# connect: the transport, at the head of the pull request that removes messaging from it and adds
# connect.NewOperatorClientSettings. A connect that still registers message.proto beside
# message's copy panics the dll at load.
connect https://github.com/urnetwork/connect.git 0f2ff66907f2c5fae735c45f687e598568ae85c4
#
# glog, gvisor and goidenticons: what connect and the core SDK replace by path. gvisor's commit
# is on urnetwork/gvisor's default branch, go.
glog https://github.com/urnetwork/glog.git 80a11b434ae90ae2221deb932daa21913919875a
gvisor https://github.com/urnetwork/gvisor.git c0783dba2eeff7b79692a7f122ffee5f8bd837c1
goidenticons https://github.com/urnetwork/goidenticons.git 06eb779a691e056be7dc5fa9a0239001c3ea390f
